The Sr2Mg12 structure (SrMg6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg and Sr each have 12 geometric neighbors, with Mg–Mg distances spanning roughly 3.00–3.60 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Mg- and Sr-centered polyhedra.
